programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Fausto hires Anton, a criminal, to assassinate Rosa Blanco; Camila and Max, happy, tell Father Tiziano about their upcoming wedding. programme.title: Piel Salvaje

programme.desc: Camila spots a woman matching her mother's description. Anton, the hitman, is also there and armed, he goes to them. Torrealba orders his men to run to the women, grab Camila and take the woman away.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Rosa Blanco makes a call to Fausto and disturbs Ezequiel with threats against him, Octavia and her entire family. Camila hears her mother's voice for the first time, but she tells her that she is calling her only to say goodbye, since they want to kill her. Camila receives a notebook sent by Rosa.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Only Camila should know the contents of what was written in the notebook. Her anger and rage grows and she thinks that her mother has the right to take revenge. Those involved feel fear and nervousness about the contents of the notebook. Max calls Camila and although she says she loves him very much, she does not express joy for the upcoming wedding.
